comments: Input facts: ego and agent1 are cars; ego initiates and agent1 responds; both share a travel lane and direction. Chosen assumptions: ego leads at 8-9 m/s with agent1 28-30 m behind at the same speed. After 2 s ego abruptly stops using SetSpeedAction(0) and remains stopped. Agent1 detects separation below 22-24 m, reacts for 0.5-0.7 s, brakes at 0.8-0.95 for 3 s, and remains stopped. This creates a sustained in-lane obstruction, unlike the temporary brake pulse. The straight non-intersection corridor and 8 s horizon are assumptions; collision is not required.
